text:
maya_support: Heads-up — Pulse Health (healthcare customer) escalated. They say audit logs for API calls between 2026-11-02T03:00:00Z and 2026-11-02T03:20:00Z are missing after a KMS rotation. They claim this impacts BAA retention requirements (7y). Also reporting a spike of 403s from /v1/audit/export and intermittent 500s on their ingest route. They attached request IDs: r-99ab2f, r-99ab31, r-99ab5c.

josh_oncall: @maya_support can you paste one of the raw request headers and the exact curl they used? we should confirm whether it's an auth issue vs export pipeline.

maya_support: pasted two excerpts the customer sent:
```
POST /v1/audit/export HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
X-Request-ID: r-99ab2f
Content-Type: application/json
{ "start": "2026-11-02T03:00:00Z", "end": "2026-11-02T03:20:00Z" }
```
and their curl returned:
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"start":"2026-11-02T03:00:00Z","end":"2026-11-02T03:20:00Z"}'
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json
{ "error": "access_denied", "message": "export not permitted for this key" }
```

priya_security: thanks. @josh_oncall @liam_sre — this looks like key scoping mismatch after rotation. Customer says they rotated keys yesterday via our KMS integration; they expected HSM-backed key to be primary per the BAA addendum. Need to confirm: which key id was active at 2026-11-02T03:05Z and whether export operation requires a different KMS policy. Also, loop in legal if retention obligations might be breached. :warning:

liam_sre: pulling KMS audit logs now. running quick query against key-usage logs for Pulse tenant id ph-004. I will paste filtered entries.

audit-bot: Created INC-2026-8437 for Pulse Health — severity: P1, assigned to support/sre/security. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-8437 :rotating_light:

liam_sre: results snippet:
```
2026-11-02T02:58:44Z key: key-phi-7 rotated -> key-phi-8
2026-11-02T03:01:02Z principal: pulse-service-account used key-phi-7 for sign
2026-11-02T03:03:57Z principal: pulse-service-account attempted export -> DENIED by policy: export_requires_hsm
2026-11-02T03:04:10Z principal: pulse-service-account used key-phi-8 for encrypt
```
Looks like rotation record at 02:58 but policy enforcement flagged export attempts before the HSM-backed key was set as allowed for export. the DENIED entry matches their 403.

josh_oncall: can we confirm whether our rotation workflow temporarily sets an intermediate key without HSM flag and if there's a window where export is blocked? If yes, that's the outage vector we need to explain and remediate.

priya_security: yes that's the hypothesis. two action items: 1) short-term: whitelist pulse tenant for export while we patch rotation logic (need approval from legal/compliance) 2) long-term: change rotation to atomically flip export policy to new key or pre-provision HSM ACL before making key active. I'll draft message for legal.

maya_support: customer wants ETA and proof they won't miss retention obligations. they've paused some jobs and asked for assisted re-run of export for the 20min window.

liam_sre: I can run an ad-hoc export if legal signs off. I have an internal script to backfill from raw events. script invocation (internal):
```
./backfill_export --tenant ph-004 --start 2026-11-02T03:00:00Z --end 2026-11-02T03:20:00Z --force-allow-export --audit-log-key key-phi-8
```
Note: --force-allow-export requires an override token from security.

priya_security: agree. I'm prepping the override auth pack and notifying legal. @josh_oncall can you prepare a short customer-facing explanation and proposed remediation timeline (ETA 2-4 hours for temporary backfill, 24-48h for rotation fix)? Keep it non-technical.

josh_oncall: will do. Draft for Maya to send to customer:
"Hi — we identified a brief policy enforcement gap during a KMS rotation that blocked export operations for a short window. We will perform an assisted backfill for the affected 20-minute window after legal approval and will deploy a rotation fix within 24–48 hours to prevent recurrence. We will share evidence of the completed export and audit records once done. Apologies for the disruption." :handshake:

maya_support: sending now. also asked customer to share signed BAA addendum copy and the exact retention clause they referenced.

priya_security: once legal signs the override, I'll generate the override token and confirm chain-of-custody for the backfill. keep INC ticket updated with attachments.

audit-bot: INC-2026-8437 updated: legal requested signed BAA copy (attachment pending).

liam_sre: performing dry-run of backfill against sandbox to validate no schema drift, then will run production after override. ETA dry-run 35m.

josh_oncall: adding postmortem tag. after resolution we should recommend: - atomic rotation step - pre-warm HSM ACLs - a pre-rotation checklist for customers using BAA/HSM combos.

maya_support: thanks everyone. ping me in thread when override issued and when export completes so I can confirm with Pulse.

priya_security: noted. I'll update here and @legal when ready. :white_check_mark:
